content.what_it_is: MATLAB diagnostic-video generator for sediment laboratory case C2. It loads a base depth and defines the horizontal coordinate (L7-L15), opens an MPEG-4 writer (L18-L23), loops over result indices 33..150 and loads/transposes surface, velocity, mask, sediment, depth, pickup/deposition, concentration, stress, avalanche and depth-offset fields (L32-L98), derives Froude number and stress quantities (L100-L125), renders 24 subplot slots of full-domain and detail views (L129-L306), captures each figure and writes video frames (L308-L320).

equations.ref: horizontal coordinate from base-depth column count
full-domain total bed-change curve includes avalanche
detail total bed-change curve omits avalanche

unresolved: The configured result directory at L4 is an absolute user-specific path; none of the repeated loads at L39-L98 checks file existence or verifies that transposed vectors match x from the base dep width at L13.
Froude uses gravitational acceleration 9.81 at L105 while sediment critical stress uses grav=9.8 from L117 at L121, creating an unexplained within-script constant mismatch.

The detail Cb/Ca panel at L241-L250 repeats axis([0 65 ...]) from the full-domain panel L230-L239 instead of using the 34..44 detail range used by adjacent paired panels; this is a copy-pattern inconsistency.

The full-domain total bed-change curve includes Aval at L286, but the detail total curve omits Aval at L299 while retaining an Ava curve and four-entry legend at L295-L303; the two Tot curves therefore have different definitions.
Tau_xy is calculated at L125 but never plotted or otherwise consumed; the stress panels use str and Tau_cr at L255-L275, so the computed formula cannot affect the video.
picka, TauEx, uu, etaa, WS, and viscosity are loaded or assigned at L73-L74,L89-L90,L100-L101,L115,L118 but not consumed by active diagnostics.
Fr can become complex or nonfinite when dep'+eta is nonpositive at L105; masking only applies where mask<1 at L102-L103 and no positivity check guards the square root.
